# Fixtures for rd_lamps_fillpaste_ab (port/render/test/rd_lamps_fillpaste_ab.cmake:
# the crack fill drawn in the glow's paste pass against a pass of its own,
# byte for byte): fixture names of this repository
# (port/render/test/fixtures/NAME.rdfix), a name a line.  The word nocull
# after a name replays that fixture with ICO_RD_CULL=off in every arm: a
# generated mesh sits about its model's origin, which for a room's lamps is
# off the picture, so the visibility test drops them and the glow's plan is
# DARK; with it off the lamps are in the chain (the LAMPS plan, as on the
# frames the fixtures were made from).  The fills each fixture lands in the
# paste's pass are its declared lamps_fillpaste_fills
# (port/render/test/fixtures/fixtures.txt).
#
# the lamps' frames: the Pixel's opening (848x448 GS), its dark room, the
# title's castle (512x512 GS): the fill lands in the glow's paste (one pass
# fewer)
fx-lamps-novolume nocull
fx-opening-dark nocull
fx-boot-0400 nocull
# the chain drawn whole (the sun's fans on the picture): the opening's sun,
# the title's castle twice: nothing lands, the same bytes, no more loaded
fx-opening-sun
fx-boot-0200
fx-boot-0600
